summary: A Yes vote enacts a general tax whose revenue goes to the City of Merced's general fund for general municipal purposes.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a one-cent sales tax to fund emergency response, public safety, youth services, roads, parks, and other city services.
tax.quote: roads/potholes; and keeping parks safe/clean, by establishing a 1¢ sales tax, providing approximately $18,000,000 annually until ended by voters
